title: The Truck on the Giant Scale
synopsis: A wheel loader fills an adult-operated road dump truck from the correct stockpile, and the yard scale checks the cargo weight before it leaves for Pine Park.
continuity_state: Before: Crushed stone has arrived from the quarry, been crushed, screened, moved by conveyor and stockpiled at the processing yard. Aunt Jo has ordered a graded mix for the small patch at Pine Park gate. No truck delivery has yet been made. After: Mr. Fred and an adult driver have prepared one green road dump truck with the specified crushed-stone blend for Pine Park. A large yellow wheel loader loaded the truck while stationary; the truck used the yard weighbridge and the operator compared loaded and empty weights. The driver has not yet delivered the load. The park repair strip remains sectioned off; all familiar routes remain in use.
